test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: One candidate received 60% of the total valid votes in an election between two candidates. A total of 20% of the votes were invalid. What is the number of valid votes the other candidate received if the total votes were 16250?
solution:
**Given:**

Candidate A received 60% of the total valid votes 

Total invalid votes = 20% of the votes 

Total votes = 16250

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Total Valid votes = Total votes (1 - 20%)

⇒ Valid votes = 16250 (1 - 0.20)

⇒ Valid votes = 16250 (0.80) = 13000 votes

Total valid votes of A = 60% of valid votes

⇒ A = 0.60 × 13000 = 7800 votes

Now total valid votes of B = Total valid votes - Valid cotes of A 

⇒ B = 13000 - 7800 = 5200 votes 

**∴ Candidate B recived 5200 valid votes.**
